verdict.rationale: The evidence lists RustDesk's capabilities: view and control, file transfer, and clipboard file copy. It also mentions per-user and device-group access control in Server Pro and "90+ options" in general terms. None of it documents scoping a connected device to view-only, control, clipboard, or file access. Pro access control decides who may reach which devices, an adjacent control that does not show capability scoping, and the vague options count cannot be credited.
